entities.summary: Mazyr or Mozyr is a city in Gomel Region, in southern Belarus. It serves as the administrative center of Mazyr District. It is situated on the Pripyat River about 210 kilometres east of Pinsk and 100 kilometres northwest of Chernobyl in Ukraine. As of 2025, it has a population of 104,517.
